focus: Form and Data Input UI Design

entries.logic: Uses GridPane for precise control over label and field alignment. Labels are typically placed in column 0, and fields in column 1 (or spanning).
entries.implementation: grid.add(label, 0, row); grid.add(field, 0, row + 1); // Or side-by-side
entries.rationale: Provides a clean, professional, and readable data entry interface that adapts well to window resizing.
